dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped light-toned rings exhibit sharp gradient transitions from light perimeters to darker centers. These are most prominent on the mid-to-posterior flank, showing irregular, non-uniform circularity with clearly defined high-contrast boundaries against the dark pelage.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Concentrated high-intensity light-gray pixel clusters are present along the upper dorsal curve due to direct illumination. Lower intensity but distinct solid light-gray speckles are distributed with moderate density between the primary annuli on the lateral midsection.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary cluster of three annuli on the central flank forms an obtuse scalene triangle. The centroid of the most posterior annulus is positioned at an approximately 20-degree downward angle relative to the centroid of the most dorsal central annulus.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex interlocking pattern of four light-colored ring structures on the posterior-lateral flank creates a unique geometric intersection resembling a clustered network.
